_comment: THROWAWAY control manifest for leg BASE. Never dispatched for real - it is fed to orchestrate.ps1 -DryRun -ManifestPath against a scratch repo. Pairs with manifest_nomodel.json, which is byte-identical except that it declares no top-level 'model'. Two legs: one declaring 'base', one not. Together the pair covers the four cells (a) leg with base (b) leg without (c) manifest with model (d) without.
_base_note: Top-level 'base' is display-only (orchestrate.ps1 prints it in the banner). It is NOT the per-leg base under test. Set to a nonsense value on purpose: if the per-leg resolution ever fell back to the manifest field, this string would appear in a resolved worktree line and the control would fail loudly.
